programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: The Decepticons create a clone of Optimus Prime to lead the Autobots into a trap.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Sorcerer Smurf: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Smurf Who Would Be King: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - April Smurf's Day: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Never Smurf Off Till Tomorrow: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: S2 Moonshot Madness
programme.desc: Rocket fails, space dreams and cosmic chaos launch Rabbids sky‑high.

programme.title: S2 Bwah‑BFFs
programme.desc: Friendships form, break and explode in classic Rabbid emotional chaos.

programme.title: S2 Cursed Bwah‑ventures
programme.desc: Glowing Rabbids, spooky spells and strange surprises everywhere.

programme.title: S2 Creature Bwah‑niverse
programme.desc: Feathers, claws and critter chaos as Rabbids meet wild new friends.

programme.title: Slapstick Bwah‑plosion
programme.desc: Falls, flops and frantic chaos in peak Rabbid slapstick style.

programme.title: Escape Bwah‑nanza
programme.desc: Breakouts, chases and runaway Rabbids in full escape mode.

programme.title: Experiment Bwah‑reakers
programme.desc: Labs erupt in chaos as Rabbids push science way too far.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Liar, Liar, Pants On Fire
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Laundry Day
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Princess or Dragon?
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn't you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Well-beeing
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: How to Train Your Plant
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Recipe For Disaster
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: The Mystery Guest
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.desc: Professor Von Schlemmer (from Too Tall Tails) has created a machine which brings dreams to life. When Robotnik hears about it, he forces the Professor to alter the machine so that nightmares come to life.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog, Adventures of
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

The public has finally had enough--as grateful as they are to have their local hero, the good citizens of Los Angeles are wondering what they ever did to deserve this guy. Hancock isn't the kind of man who cares what other people think--until the day that he saves the life of PR executive Ray Embrey, and the sardonic superhero begins to realize that he may have a vulnerable side after all. Facing that will be Hancock's greatest challenge yet--and a task that may prove impossible as Ray's wife, Mary, insists that he's a lost cause.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Epic Ke Dus is a halfhour collated list of the top ten people, places or events of a chosen topic, examples of which include rivalries, thinkers and warriors. Each topic has been thoroughly researched and a panel of experts on the subject has carefully selected the stories that are fitting to be part of the topic. This panel is seen on the episodes giving their views on the events, the significance of the event and describing the mood of the era, publics reaction to these events and how it contributed to change the course of Indian history.

programme.title: Kissa Currency Ka
programme.desc: The introduction of currency was a key step in the evolution of civilization. As the kingdoms and dynasties across the country rose and fell, they left their mark on the currency they produced. This series explores the coins minted by each kingdom in Indian history, and uses stories about the coins to tell the history of the kingdom itself.

programme.title: The Way Back Home

Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology - Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Totò non ha intenzione di far parte dell'organizzazione di Le Capitaine, e la loro rivalità causa una sanguinosa guerra tra bande.

programme.title: Il sorriso della iena
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della madre in circostanze ambigue, un'adolescente inizia a sospettare che il suo patrigno, rimasto vedovo da poco, possa essere coinvolto.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Primo film da protagonista di Lino Banfi. Degradato e infine espulso dalla polizia per inettitudine comprovata, il brigadiere pugliese Pasquale Zagaria si ritira a vita privata nella campagna romana. Ma ben presto resta coinvolto in un oscuro traffico di diamanti. Con l'aiuto della vigorosa moglie Pupetta, cintura nera di karate, Zagaria torna ad affrontare i delinquenti.

programme.title: I Cadetti di Guascogna
programme.desc: Bellissima commedia piena di divertenti equivoci con Walter Chiari e Ugo Tognazzi. Walter e Ugo hanno un debole per la bella Vittoria, ma il padre, che nulla vuole saperne, spedisce la ragazza a Bracciano, dalla zia. Caso vuole, però, che entrambi i pretendenti ricevano una chiamata che li destina proprio sulle rive del lago laziale dove, incontrata la dolce fanciulla, accade una cosa imprevista.

programme.title: Il Mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano Garbelli, impiegato romano, viene coinvolto dalla prostituta Daniela, che lo indica come suo protettore per difendersi dai magnaccia. Daniela si finge infermiera, suscitando l'interesse di Stefano. Inconsapevolmente, Stefano diventa il suo protettore agli occhi dei rivali e della polizia, che lo convoca al commissariato insieme agli aggressori.

programme.title: Parigi è sempre Parigi
programme.desc: Nominato al Leone d'Oro per la regia di Luciano Emmer. Una comitiva di italiani si reca a Parigi per assistere alla partita di calcio Italia-Francia. Di questa comitiva fanno parte la famiglia De Angelis, composta da padre, madre e figlia con il relativo fidanzato, e due giovanotti, amici inseparabili.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Broken
programme.desc: L'undicenne inglese Skunk Cunningham è una ragazzina come tante, con un papà un po' distratto, che le vuole bene, un fratello maggiore, Broken, che è il suo idolo, una mamma che è andata via di casa. E un professore che le fa adorare la scuola e la incoraggia a seguire le sue aspirazioni, nonostante viva in un ambiente in cui regnano la brutalità e il degrado. Nella grigia periferia della provincia inglese spadroneggia, infatti, la famiglia Oswald, padre tossico con cinque figlie violente e aggressive, che semina la paura minacciando e derubando chiunque gli capiti a tiro.

programme.title: Rabbit Hole
programme.desc: Rabbit Hole è un adattamento dell'omonima pièce teatrale di David Lindsay-Abaire, vincitrice del Premio Pulitzer nel 2007. La storia ruota intorno a Becca (Nicole Kidman) ed Howie (Aaron Eckhart) una coppia newyorkese che ha perso il figlio di 4 anni in un incidente stradale. Le cose si complicano ulteriormente quando Becca si mette sulle tracce del giovane ragazzo che ha provocato l'incidente…La regia è firmata da John Cameron Mitchell autore del controverso “Shortbus” mentre della sceneggiatura si è occupato lo stesso Lindsay-Abaire. Nel cast figurano anche Tammy Blanchard, Dianne Wiest e Sandra Oh.

programme.title: La Gatta
programme.desc: Cora, detta "La Gatta", fa parte di un gruppo partigiano. Il suo amante si spaccia per un giornalista svizzero, ma in realtà è un ufficiale tedesco, il cui compito è quello di smantellare la resistenza in quella regione. Quando Cora si accorge di come stanno le cose è troppo tardi: i suoi compagni vengono tutti arrestati e lei viene uccisa per aver tradito.

programme.title: La ragazza senza nome
programme.desc: Una sera, a fine giornata, Jenny, una giovane dottoressa, sente suonare alla porta, ma non risponde. Il giorno dopo, la polizia la informa che una donna ancora non identificata è stata trovata morta nelle vicinanze.

programme.title: CUORI FORTUNATI
programme.desc: Una produttrice di cosmetici ottiene la sua grande occasione quando collabora con un dirigente finanziario per rendere i suoi prodotti più commerciabili. Riuscirà a mantenere la magia che ha reso il suo trucco un tale successo?

programme.title: IL CLUB DELL'AMORE: IL VIAGGIO DI SYDNEY
programme.desc: Sydney è un'ex atleta che ora fa la food blogger. In tutto questo, nel suo cuore non sembra mai essere passata la cotta per Theo, suo ex cmpagno di college. E rivedersi dopo 10 anni cambierà qualcosa?

programme.title: Elle
programme.desc: Elle vorrebbe essere una cantante ma i suoi sogni si infrangono. Inizialmente sfruttata per il suo talento dallo zio, si troverà a vivere il piacere di cantare dopo un incontro fortuito con la pop sta Ty Parker

programme.title: 10 YEARS
programme.desc: Channing Tatum e il temuto momento della verità: la reunion dopo 10 anni coi compagni del liceo. Chi ha avuto successo? Chi ha cambiato vita? Chi è ancorato nel passato? Un cast stellare e l'ultima possibilità per mettere da parte vecchie ferite o riaprire amori in sospeso nel tempo. Gelosie, insicurezze, rivincite il tutto mischiato con una maturità solo apparente.

programme.title: UNA SQUADRA PERFETTA
programme.desc: Quando la designer Rebecca mente durante un colloquio di lavoro dicendo di essere una leader sicura di sé, la sua bugia viene messa alla prova durante un ritiro sulle montagne di Tahoe. Le viene assegnato come partner Nathan, che detesta profondamente la vita all'aria aperta.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: David di Donatello per la miglior regia. Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere. Una Roma di fine anni '50 nel classico con Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grande Vittorio De Sica.

programme.title: Miseria e nobiltà
programme.desc: La storia delle umili famiglie di Felice Pasquale e del suo collega che vengono assunte da un marchese che vuole sposare la figlia di un ricco ma semplice cuoco, così si atteggiano a aristocratici.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e la...Malafemmina
programme.desc: Il cavalier Cocozza e il ragionier D'Amore hanno in comune solo una parlantina inarrestabile e una potente vocazione polemica. I due, acerrimi nemici, negano il consenso alle nozze dei loro figli che le proveranno tutte per riuscire a sposarsi.

programme.title: Shaolin Basket
programme.desc: Shi-Jie viene trovato da bambino nella spazzatura e cresciuto in un'accademia di arti marziali. Arrivato all'università, entra nella squadra di basket e insegna il Kung Fu ai suoi compagni per far colpo sulla sorella del capitano della squadra!

programme.title: 47 Metri: Great White
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: Santa Sangre
programme.desc: Fuggito da un manicomio, Fenix torna nel mondo guidato dalla madre mutilata. L'inizio di un'odissea visionaria tra follia, sangue e illusioni.

programme.title: Daybreakers L'ultimo vampiro
programme.desc: Un'epidemia ha trasformato quasi tutti gli umani in vampiri, costringendo i pochi superstiti a nascondersi. Edward Dalton, un vampiro che rifiuta il sangue umano, lavora per creare un'alternativa sintetica e salvare l'umanità con l'aiuto della sopravvissuta Audrey.

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Un Ragionevole Dubbio
programme.desc: Mitch, un brillante procuratore, investe accidentalmente un passante, scappando senza prestargli soccorso. Dopo aver scoperto che un uomo è stato arrestato al suo posto, i sensi di colpa spingeranno Mitch a far cadere le accuse. E se Mitch si fosse sbagliato? Se quell'uomo non fosse innocente?

programme.title: Puoi baciare la damigella
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'influencer affermata di New York con una passione per la pasticceria. La ragazza, però, dovrà lasciare per breve tempo il suo nuovo impiego per prendere parte al matrimonio di sua sorella, da organizzare all'interno della loro vecchia casa, ora di proprietà del suo ex fidanzato Liam.

programme.title: Un pizzico d'amore
programme.desc: Un esperto culinario ha il compito di elevare la personalità del marchio di un canale alimentare. Mentre le loro personalità crollano, iniziano a rendersi conto che il contrasto può essere buono in amore come lo è nel cibo.

programme.title: Vuoi cucinare con me?
programme.desc: Joel è l'arrogante proprietario di una famosa catena di fast food a base di piatti messicani. Alla ricerca di nuovi piatti da proporre con successo nel menu, parte per il New Mexico, dove la grintosa Javiera Torres è famosa per le sue prelibatezze culinarie.

programme.title: Sempre nel mio cuore
programme.desc: Jenna e Charlie hanno trovato l'amore in Irlanda, ma i loro sogni li hanno separati. Cinque anni dopo, si riuniscono e Jenna deve decidere a chi appartiene il suo cuore: tornare a casa o sull'Isola di Smeraldo.

programme.title: Una dolce occasione
programme.desc: La madre di Cate sta organizzando degli appuntamenti per sua figlia, amministratore delegato di un'azienda. Quando incontra Gabe una settimana prima di Natale, pensa che sia un suo appuntamento, ma lui è un consulente aziendale per la sua azienda produttrice di bastoncini di zucchero.

programme.title: La favola di Emma
programme.desc: Emma ha creato un sito dedicato al lifestyle chiamato Classically Emma, mettendoci tutta la sua passione. Ma quando le sue statistiche iniziano a calare, considera di unirsi alla determinata Jill come soluzione.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da salvare
programme.desc: Jess e Max sono pronti ad annullare il loro matrimonio per lo stress eccessivo causato dal l'organizzazione fuori controllo dell'evento e da tutto quello che ne è conseguito. Ormai alla frutta, si recano da Billie, una dolce 'sempre damigella d'onore' che ha un'associazione no-profit che si occupa di donare alle persone meno abbienti e con bisogni speciali, allestimenti di feste di matrimonio già pagati e mai avvenuti. Tuttavia, Charlie, il fratello di Max, non si fermerà davanti a nulla pur di tenere insieme Jess e Max e per fare ciò, chiede aiuto a Billie, allettandola con un aiuto extra per la sua attività.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere su una rubrica anonima di consigli d'amore. Lì incontra il caporedattore Morgan Cooper. Tra i due scocca subito la scintilla. Sarà proprio Audrey ad essere la nuova protagonista di una delle storie d'amore di cui scrive?

programme.title: Avventure di un uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente strano, un dirigente aziendale diventa completamente invisibile, scappa e viene cacciato da un ufficiale infido della CIA mentre cerca di affrontare la sua nuova realtà.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: Una giovane donna nera scopre che suo padre è stato un donatore di sperma, e se non fosse già abbastanza brutto, è bianco!

programme.title: Perfect Sense
programme.desc: Michael, uno chef solitario, incontra casualmente Susan, un'epidemiologa, reduce da diverse delusioni amorose. I due si innamorano, ma la dottoressa deve confrontarsi con i primi pazienti colpiti da una pandemia globale.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack è uno scrittore in difficoltà i cui ideali di speranza sono stati soppressi dal rifiuto e dalla solitudine, ma la sua vita è destinata a cambiare in seguito all'incontro con Maria, una ragazza allegra e molto superstiziosa.

programme.title: La salsa dell'amore
programme.desc: Zoey decide di affittare un camioncino e di partecipare per gioco a una gara di un reality in TV. Tra lei e l'affascinante fondatore di una catena di fast food sembra accendersi la passione, ma quando Zoey scopre che lui è un giudice del concorso, le cose precipitano rapidamente.

programme.title: Bouquet d'amore
programme.desc: Quando la talentuosa botanica Violet ha bisogno di aiuto per preparare le composizioni floreali per un matrimonio di alto profilo, si rivolge a Jack, un affascinante fotografo naturalista che si è assunto la responsabilità di gestire il vivaio di fiori del nonno.

programme.title: L'atelier dei miei sogni
programme.desc: La stilista Skye gira con il suo "furgoncino della moda", ma non è in condizione di guidare e gestire l'attività da sola. L'aiuto arriva sotto l'improbabile forma dell'affascinante imprenditore Kevin. Lavorando insieme, Skye e Kevin scoprono di avere in comune più di quanto pensassero...

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Un Natale di ricordi
programme.desc: Darcy e Aiden sono rattristati dall'imminente chiusura del centro ricreativo della loro comunità. Per salvarlo, e con esso lo spirito natalizio, Darcy e Aiden intraprendono un viaggio dove un ospite inaspettato unisce tutti per una vacanza magica.

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis torna nella sua città natale per aprire una location per matrimoni, solo per affrontare l'opposizione del suo ex fidanzato Will Mason e degli altri locali.

programme.title: Un amore da ricordare
programme.desc: Tenley trova finalmente il coraggio di incontrare dal vivo Jared, conosciuto online un anno prima. Quando questi ha un incidente, l'ospedale fa firmare i documenti a Tenley, facendo credere alla famiglia di Jared che i due siano sposati.

programme.title: Un Matrimonio Da Salvare
programme.desc: Billie is the charming owner of a wedding donation company. Her clients, Max and Jess, are calling the wedding off. Billie and Charlie, Max's brother, will have to work together to get this couple hitched. Maybe this time, it's time for Billie's wedding!

programme.title: Vendemmia d'amore
programme.desc: L'avvocato Sarah Stein si occupa di un caso riguardante un'eredità ma tutti i famigliari litigano tra di loro.

programme.title: Chiamatemi Helen
programme.desc: Un celebre chef affronta il percorso di transizione della figlia, nata maschio.

programme.title: L'amore dietro la maschera
programme.desc: Elyse e Rob vivono una moderna e capovolta versione della storia d'amore raccontata dalla fiaba di ...

programme.title: Sotto una romantica luna
programme.desc: Quando il veterinario Eric viene chiamato da Jane per prendersi cura di una cavalla, si innamora della donna.

programme.title: Isole
programme.desc: Ivan si alza presto ogni mattina da Tirana per prendere il traghetto per le isole Tremiti e lavorare come muratore. All'ennesimo giorno senza paga, fa pressioni per ottenere i suoi soldi e viene picchiato da tre abitanti locali. L'unica presente alla scena disposta a soccorrerlo è Martina, nota reietta dell'isola chiusa in un silenzio inviolabile e affascinata solo dal mondo delle api. Impossibilitato a tornare in Albania per mancanza di soldi, Ivan trova ospitalità presso la casa canonica dove Martina abita assieme al suo tutore, don Enzo, un anziano sacerdote invalido e bisognoso di cure. Questi, quasi per dispetto nei confronti della sorella, decide di accogliere in casa Ivan e, nonostante le prime gelosie, di accettare che fra lo straniero impacciato e l'introversa ragazza nasca un sentimento.

programme.title: Una Vita da Sogno
programme.desc: Una commedia sul gioco degli equivoci condita con una buona dose d'ironia e arti marziali. Il protagonista infatti si finge quello che non è per cercare di conquistare una bella ragazza… Ma anche lei a sua volta fa la stessa cosa. E quindi inizia una girandola di situazioni inaspettate ed esilaranti…

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Alice Harvey, ventinovenne assistente editor e aspirante scrittrice, è divertente, intelligente ed emotivamente autodistruttiva. Scalando le fila di una importante casa editrice, si sforza di scrivere la propria storia da sempre ostacolata dai ricordi della sua relazione giovanile con Milan, il miglior amico di suo padre. Dopo 15 anni, i percorsi di Alice e Milan si incrociano ancora una volta, costringendo i due a confrontarsi con eventi che sono ormai lontani.

programme.title: Flirting with Flamenco
programme.desc: Sylvia, insicura e con problemi sul lavoro, incontra il chitarrista di flamenco Pablo, il quale cambia la sua vita. Ma una rivelazione sconvolgente del padre la mette alla prova: riuscirà a reagire?

programme.title: La banda grossi
programme.desc: Una storia tutta italiana ambientata nelle Marche del 1860 all'alba dello Stato Italiano

programme.title: Kimba
programme.desc: Kimba è un cucciolo di leone bianco, figlio dell'imperatore della giungla, Panja. Kimba è gentile con gli altri animali, però è un pessimo cacciatore, ha persino paura di saltare. A causa di questa sua debolezza, gli altri animali lo deridono. Koko, è l'unica che crede in lui e conosce le sue potenzialità.

programme.title: Life In A Day
programme.desc: La vita in un giorno è un film documentario il cui progetto - un esperimento globale per la creazione del più grande lungometraggio generato dagli utenti - è stato annunciato da YouTube il 6 luglio 2010. È classificato come il primo Social Movie della storia

programme.title: Come se non ci fosse un domani
programme.desc: Intrappolato in un ciclo di salti temporali, trasportato un anno avanti in una manciata di minuti, Teddy deve affrontare una corsa contro il tempo mentre la sua vita si sgretola intorno a lui.

programme.title: La quadriglia dell'amore
programme.desc: Un produttore di riviste e un attore della sua compagnia si recano rispettivamente a Londra e a Parigi per trovare una soubrette per il loro spettacolo. Non solo entrambi hanno successo, ma s'innamorano anche delle loro scoperte.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Dopo dieci anni di matrimonio e due bambini, la relazione sessuale di Annie e Jay non è più quella di una volta. Per renderla di nuovo più viva, decidono di filmarsi mentre fanno sesso, ma poi si accorgono che il video è stato rubato …

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: Marisa Tomei è Faith che crede fermamente negli astri e sin da ragazza una chiromante le predice che l'uomo della sua vita sarà un certo Damon Bradley. Pochi giorni prima di sposare un podologo, finalmente arriva la telefonata di Damon per farle gli augur mentre sta per partire per Venezia.

programme.title: L'asilo dei papà
programme.desc: Rimasti senza lavoro, Charlie (Eddie Murphy) e Phil (Jeff Garlin) non possono più permettersi il costoso asilo Chapman Academy.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Liberamente ispirato alla striscia di fumetti Little Orphan Annie, il film racconta la storia di un'orfanella che viene ospitata per una settimana nella villa di un ricco possidente che successivamente propone all'orfanotrofio che ospita la piccola di adottarla. La direttrice dell'istituto si opporrà però con tutte le sue forze all'adozione della piccola Annie.

programme.title: I baroni
programme.desc: Leopoldo, impotente prima delle nozze, guarisce grazie a una danese, ma deve sposare Mariantonia per ereditare.

programme.title: Sesso e volentieri
programme.desc: Dieci piccoli episodi collegati dal filo rosso del ""sesso e volentieri""

programme.title: Il paramedico
programme.desc: Mario vince un'auto, ma dopo un furto da parte dei terroristi finisce in carcere.

programme.title: Il marito in collegio
programme.desc: Carlotta sposa il benzinaio Camillo per l'eredità, ma lo manda in Svizzera per diventare raffinato.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Invitati per forza (The People We Hate at the Wedding)
programme.desc: In questa esilarante commedia irriverente, i fratelli americani disfunzionali Alice e Paul – insieme alla loro mamma sempre ottimista – sono invitati al matrimonio britannico della loro sorellastra lontana, Eloise, come un'opportunità per riconnettersi come adulti e imparare ad amarsi come un tempo.

programme.title: Qualcosa di troppo
programme.desc: Jeanne è una madre single con alle spalle un divorzio e una discreta insofferenza verso gli uomini. Finché una mattina si risveglia con una sorpresa che le cambierà completamente la vita.Con i protagonisti di “Non sposate le mie figlie” e “La famiglia Belier”.

programme.title: Ladre per Caso
programme.desc: Carole è un'informatica introversa che vive ancora da sua madre. Caroline è una borseggiatrice ribelle che saccheggia i grandi hotel della Costa Azzurra. Le due giovani donne non si conoscono e non hanno niente in comune. Niente scomparso prima della loro nascita e che non hanno mai visto.

programme.title: Il club delle mamme single
programme.desc: Quando cinque mamme single in difficoltà mettono da parte le loro differenze per formare un gruppo di sostegno, trovano ispirazione e allegria nella loro nuova associazione e si aiutano a vicenda per superare gli imprevisti che ostacolano il loro cammino.

programme.title: Stregata dalla luna (Moonstruck)
programme.desc: In questa classica commedia romantica, una vedova di Brooklyn (Cher) è pronta a risposarsi. Solo che questa volta, ha intenzione di farlo per bene, anche se dovrà dire “sì” a un uomo che in realtà non ama.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: I due pezzi da 90
programme.desc: Franco e Ciccio sono costretti ad abbandonare il loro salumificio per raggiungere il padrino di Franco: Nico Cavallaro. I due non sanno che costui è un contrabbandiere di droga e che vuole servirsi di loro per trasportare la merce.

programme.title: Il clan dei due Borsalini
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco alle prese con un "colpo" ai danni di una gioielleria. I due maldestri ladri verranno acciuffati e finiranno in prigione.

programme.title: Interstate 60
programme.desc: Dal creatore di Ritorno al Futuro. Neil è un pittore ostacolato dal padre che vorrebbe vederlo laureato in legge. La situazione cambia all'improvviso quando incontra One Wish Grant (premio Oscar Gary Oldman), uomo in grado di esaudire ogni desiderio.

programme.title: Il Terrore dei Mari
programme.desc: Tra arrembaggi e inseguimenti nei mari tropicali, un audace pirata sfida flotte nemiche e tradimenti per conquistare libertà e tesori. Un'avventura ricca di azione e colpi di scena, firmata da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Il Terrore dei Barbari

programme.title: I dieci gladiatori

programme.title: Il Gladiatore di Roma
programme.desc: Nell'arena e nei palazzi del potere, un gladiatore combatte tra intrighi e duelli per cambiare il proprio destino.

programme.title: L'assedio di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all'avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: La valle dei bruti
programme.desc: Nel 1892, dopo la morte di Phil Evarts, il suo ranch viene minacciato da allevatori avidi e ladri di bestiame. Il fratello John e la figlia Celia cercano di proteggere l'Hatchet Ranch. Will Ballard, fidato caposquadra, si batte per salvaguardare gli interessi di Celia, mentre il fidanzato di quest'ultima, Sam Danfelser, tradisce e si allea con i nemici. Con l'aiuto dello sceriffo e dei Marshals, la battaglia per il ranch raggiunge un climax drammatico.

programme.title: Una donna chiamata Apache
programme.desc: L'ufficiale Tommy salva la splendida Yara Kewa da un crudele trafficante d'armi, Honest Jeremy. Il loro amore nasce tra tensioni e pericoli, ma la vendetta del contrabbandiere incombe. Quando Jeremy li rintraccia, la violenza esplode. Riusciranno Tommy e Yara Kewa a sfuggire al loro destino e trovare la pace?

programme.title: I lunghi giorni della vendetta

In order to transmit alien data, the extraordinary robot is infused with a powerful telepathic device that enables it to instantly read and even feel emotions.

A vampire and witch, Isabella was staked through the heart and burned to death in the 14th century. But at the coming of the 25th moon, Isabella will reincarnate in another body... the body of a beautiful virgin!

Ignorano pero che ben presto diventeranno i protagonisti di un video successivo, in cui si ritroveranno ad affrontare la propria morte.

programme.title: Tra le tenebre AKA Between the Darkness

Questo gigante stellare comincia ad emettere le sue micidiali microonde minacciando così la Terra e tutte le forme di vita che la abitano. Ma c'è ancora una speranza.

Quando Harriet Franklin, Presidente degli Stati Uniti, apprende che sull'aereo viaggia anche suo fratello, è chiamata a scegliere tra la sua famiglia e la sicurezza delle persone nelle città sottostanti, qualora il velivolo fosse costretto a schiantarsi al suolo.

programme.title: Frontier

programme.title: Rec 2

Horror catastrofico ecologico di produzione italiana (il regista è Fabrizio De Angelis sotto pseudonimo), con la vecchia star di Hollywood Van Johnson.

Ambientato nell'Amburgo del 1970, il film indaga la vita segreta e le frequentazioni di quello che si rivelerà un vero e proprio mostro. Tutto ruota attorno al bar che da il nome al romanzo, dove Fritz passa la maggior parte del suo tempo.

Il trio si ritrova in un'area abbandonata. Improvvisamente tutto diviene buio e i tre perdono conoscienza. Quando Nic, uno dei giovani, si risveglia, si ritrova in un orribile incubo.

programme.title: Colmic
programme.sub-title: Bolognese DNA - I Grandi Cavedani del Chiese - Ep.2
programme.desc: Bentornati su Bolognese DNA! In questo nuovo episodio ci spostiamo sulle acque del fiume Chiese insieme a Maurizio Fedeli, per una classica giornata invernale dedicata alla pesca al cavedano. In questa stagione le mangiate saranno sicuramente meno frequenti, ma quando arrivano… spesso portano con sé pesci di taglia. Una pescata tecnica, fatta di attenzione, lettura dell'acqua, approccio leggero e tanta precisione, dove ogni dettaglio può fare la differenza. Per affrontare al meglio questa sessione, la scelta è ricaduta sulla Colmic WR T 8001 – 16 g da 6 metri, una canna che si è dimostrata perfetta per la pescata di oggi: precisa, affidabile e ideale per interpretare al meglio questo tipo di situazione.Buona visione e benvenuti in un nuovo episodio di Bolognese DNA!
